reading: The same house twice. Left, repaint: an AI agent painted on a cracked facade, documents lying loose in the ground. Right, renovate: the house renewed from the foundations up – documents filed with an owner, one model gateway, scoped tools, an AI agent that hands exceptions to a person who stays and is retrained, secured walls, an inspection under the roof.
